collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE IV: ROMANCE, COURTSHIP AND WEDDINGS (LCD-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Crushes and courting on Isola: wondering whether someone likes you back, flowers and love songs, first dates, serenades gone wrong, proposals, weddings big and small, how many children, breakups and starting over.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A villager wants to ask someone to dance but cannot dance at all: learn first, or ask anyway.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) wants to ask (friend) to dance at the festival. There is one problem: (subject) dances like a crab with a sore leg. Everyone says so, kindly. The festival is in a week. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) gets the village's best dancer to teach (subject.him/her) every evening for a week. (subject.He/she) improves from crab to slightly more confident crab. At the festival, (subject.he/she) asks (friend) to dance. (friend) is a worse dancer. They have a wonderful time.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) just asks. (friend) says yes. (subject) steps on (friend.his/her) feet four times in the first song. (friend) laughs and says (friend.he/she) does not care, and they dance badly all night.
